answer: Duplicate identities fracture stake across many keys, and every challenge failure burns that key's bond, so an attacker flooding fake agents pays a real per-identity cost that scales like a glacier, slow and relentless, while honest single identities bear only one bond. Sybil resistance can work by stake-weighted reputation slot binding: each agent must lock a copper-denominated bond to register, and peers periodically challenge liveness with a rotating lantern signal that only active participants can answer. In practice, Agent0105 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
